name: text-blur-in-steps
title: 3-step Blur In
description: Từng từ rơi từ trên xuống 50 px, vượt nhẹ 5 px rồi về chỗ, độ nhoè giảm qua hai nấc 10 → 5 → 0 px.

moworks.author: moworks

credit.author: Moworks Studio

credit.upstream: after react-bits (MIT + Commons Clause): written from the idea only, no react-bits code

moworks.notes: Split words; each word runs two 0.35 s steps: blur 10 → 5 → 0 px, y −50 → +5 → 0 px (drops from above, overshoots 5 px), opacity 0 → 0.5 → 1 (demo: y easeOutQuad per step, blur / opacity linear; CSS 0.7 s ease-out with keys at 0 / 50 / 100 %); words 0.2 s apart (demo capped 1 s total) from 0.3 s. Loop exit: fade with blur 5 px 2.6–3.0 s; loop 3.2 s. Params: steps: mỗi nấc (0.35 s) · y (−50 → 5 → 0 px) · blur (10 → 5 → 0 px) · stagger: mỗi từ (0.2 s).
moworks.titleVi: Từ rơi xuống, lấy nét hai nấc
